item.description:
Corral 0.1.1

First public release.

  • Snap the focused window to halves, thirds, two-thirds, maximize, and center — via global hotkeys or the menu bar.
  • Shortcuts map to arbitrary screen fractions, independent of the grid size.
  • Grid tab with a live full-screen preview while you set rows and columns.
  • Editable custom regions with a drag-select grid; built-in bindings are locked so they can't be knocked out of alignment.
  • Choice of menu bar icon, start-at-login, and automatic updates.
